```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert year and date to datetime
customer_segments['Year_Birth'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Year_Birth'], format='%Y')
customer_segments['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(customer_segments['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Create a violin plot for income distribution across marital status
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.violinplot(x='Marital_Status', y='Income', data=customer_segments)
plt.title('Income Distribution Across Marital Status')
plt.xlabel('Marital Status')
plt.ylabel('Income')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
```
